properties.description:
One change since v0.68.0: get_skill accepts the word a person types. "gaps", "/gaps", "/where" and "/impact-check" each return their skill (skills::resolve), and the reply's `requested_as` says what was asked for. A command that is a tool (/debt, /decisions, /next) still refuses and names the tool.

Measured on flo2's connector: a chat model asked for "gaps", was refused, and asked again for "detect-and-ask".

Minor, because get_skill's result gains an optional field. No schema stamp change (28 node types, 65 edge types, schema_version 1), so no upgrade note. Also carries the design-only record from #582: a hub starts a new child design by opening it from the same session.
properties.name: v0.69.0 — get_skill serves the skill a slash command names
